info.name: Joplin
info.summary: Browse your Joplin notes inside Nextcloud
info.description:
A dedicated Joplin notes app for Nextcloud.
Browse, read and search the Joplin notes that your Joplin clients already sync to Nextcloud — directly from the Nextcloud web UI, as a native app with its own header entry.
Features: - Native Nextcloud app with a header navigation entry - Lists notebooks (folders) and notes from your Joplin sync folder - Shows human-readable titles (not GUID filenames) - Renders Markdown content (read-only viewer) - Full-text search over titles and note bodies - Reconstructs the notebook hierarchy from Joplin metadata (parent_id) - Hides Joplin internal metadata from the UI - Index caching for fast repeated browsing - Does NOT modify, rename or rewrite any Joplin files — read only
This app is independent of the "Joplin File Titles" app; both can be enabled together.
info.author: Schuyler 'Rocky' Reidel
